result.title: LoopSight: Looped Vision Transformers with Gated Prediction Memory
result.summary: Looped vision transformers extend computation for visual reasoning by repeatedly applying a shared Transformer core. A challenge is to preserve useful prediction information across loop iterations while allowing the computation state to evolve. In this paper we introduce LoopSight, a looped vision transformer that uses Gated Prediction Memory (GPM) to maintain a persistent prediction state for readout, separate from the core's evolving computation state. At each iteration, a cross-attention gate uses the core's candidate features, the previous prediction state, and the current task state to control writes at the patch and channel level. The model decodes its prediction from the updated memory. We condition the shared core on the current iteration using asymptotic loop encoding and train the model by supervising its prediction at loop counts sampled from a truncated Gaussian distribution. LoopSight outperforms LoopViT across three model scales on ARC-AGI-1 and ARC-AGI-2. On ARC-AGI-1, LoopSight-Small achieves 67.4% pass@2, a gain of 6.6 percentage points over LoopViT-Small with comparable parameter counts and FLOPs. LoopSight also outperforms LoopViT on Visual Sudoku and ImageNet classification. Further analyses on ARC-AGI-1 show that LoopSight preserves more already-correct predictions and maintains more stable readout features as its computation state continues to evolve. The code will be released at https://github.com/feufhd/LoopSight.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 LoopSight：循环复用共享 Transformer 核心的视觉 Transformer，增设 Gated Prediction Memory，用 cross-attention 门控在 patch 与通道层面控制写入，把用于读出的持续预测状态与不断演化的计算状态分离，并以渐进循环编码和对截断高斯采样的循环次数做监督。
AI.relevance_reason: 直接对应循环计算与预测工作区这一关注点，其「预测状态与计算状态分离、跨迭代门控写入」可为 latent 状态的保持与更新方式提供参照，循环次数采样训练与读出稳定性分析也与长度泛化和动态计算成本相关，值得核查。
